summary: R223 closes the remaining fixed-function compiler-readiness gap in ExactSamples: the bounded unique-signature probe now requires both the generated R93 vertex shader and R84 pixel shader to compile successfully before a signature can be cached as compiler-exact. NativeDrawPath remains dormant.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered authenticated vr-dx11-native-r71 HEAD 96d4c42ac56626294a44b205c22a417a0545c28b; read AGENTS.md, VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_INDEX.md/Set05, QUEUE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md, CONVERSION_LANE_STATE.json, VR_AUTODEV_STATE.json, VR_RUN_STATE.md, VR_REGRESSION_KNOWLEDGE.json, VR_PROBLEM_HISTORY.md and Issue #14. R222/00317 is durable and was not repeated.

C1_REVIEW.finding: R222 makes ExactSamples consume actual fixed-function pixel D3DCompile success, but the per-signature vertex side still stops at generated-source readiness. The R93 vertex source varies with FVF/input semantics, so a generated vertex shader that fails D3DCompile could still be counted exact.

review_lenses.architecture: Mirror the existing diagnostic-only pixel compiler probe for the R93 vertex source and require pair success; no native draw ownership change.
review_lenses.ownership_lifetime: Generated source and bytecode remain temporary diagnostic data; no D3D11 device object, reset, resource generation, shared-surface or transport lifetime changes.
review_lenses.stereo_correctness: No WVP values, eye routing, HUD, OpenXR submission or presentation behavior changes.
review_lenses.performance: Compile only newly tracked fixed-function signatures under the existing SignatureHashCap=512; repeated signatures reuse the cached pair-success identity.
review_lenses.adversarial: Vertex compile failure, pixel compile failure, missing prototype, signature-cap overflow, and a racing repeat before the first pair probe completes remain non-exact.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Added a diagnostic R93 vertex D3DCompile probe (vs_4_0), retained generated vertex source in the sampled signature for the bounded unique-signature probe, required VS+PS pair compile success before admitting FixedFunctionShaderCompileExactHashes, and extended hosted semantic/static contracts.

C3_VALIDATE.evidence: Attempts 1 and 2 were cancelled by same-branch concurrency after static checks passed; no code/test failure was observed. Attempt 3 adds a negative hosted semantic assertion for fail-closed unsupported vertex prototypes, then requires one uninterrupted exact-SHA Backend Conversion Gate.

C5_PACKAGE.reason: Dormant compiler-readiness/census evidence only; no runtime candidate or package identity changes.

C6_STATE.exact_next_action: Publish one attempt-3 material result SHA with the R223 negative semantic assertion, allow only that SHA's Backend Conversion Gate to run, then persist PASS bookkeeping separately with CI skip.
